name: PORTICO
description: You are here before you enter.
prompt: What is the condition of your approach?

constitution.ontology: Forty-four deposits mention this locus in body text; none takes it as subject. As a threshold rather than a room, it may be constituted by the act of crossing rather than by a specification — but no document states that, and the archive does not supply the reasoning on the locus’s behalf. Declared unspecified pending either a specification or a ruling that thresholds are constituted differently from rooms.

gap_declaration.rule: Declared absence is inert; undeclared absence gets filled in. This locus carries no constituting document and the archive says so rather than allowing a retrieval system to supply one.
